correctness.rationale: Fourier diagonalization yields an exactly transverse first conjugate crossing with three strictly stable other modes. Explicit bilinear tensors and resolvents derive the coefficient without a neglected cubic term. Symbolic checker verifies rational reduction. Exact signs and Descartes prove exactly two positive simple zeros; positive denominator and nonresonance allow the local Neimark–Sacker theorem. Exclusions are stated.

value.rationale: Nonreciprocal five-node logistic dynamics exhibits a nontrivial subcriticality window bracketed by two exact degeneracy thresholds, unlike the three-node result and unlike statements based solely on spectral onset. This changes whether small oscillatory invariant states exist on the stable or unstable equilibrium side and supplies a rigorous test model for finite chiral network dynamics.
